comment: 66,000 collaborative robots installed in 2025, 11% of all industrial robot installations. This is a share of installations, not a survey of manufacturers, so it does not meet the rule for level 3. Says nothing about how many use AI. Page opened and confirmed by the assistant.

source: World Cement, 2024; Cambridge Enterprise (University of Cambridge)
comment: Heidelberg Materials runs Carbon Re's AI on the kiln of its Mokra cement plant (Czechia), on top of the existing ABB control system. Reported after the first month of closed-loop operation, validated in a one-month-on, one-month-off test: fuel cost index down 4.1% and a 33% lower variation in a clinker quality measure. Carbon Re now trades as Gigaton; the owner saw Heidelberg Materials among the companies shown on its website. The two reports were found by web search and their pages were not opened by the assistant; the figures are early and not independently verified. AI-specific. Cement industry only.
